Name: Precise vs. Approximate Numeracy in Stroke Participants
Funding: National Institute of Health Grant F31DC020370-03
EthicsApprovals: All data acquired from studies that were approved by the Institutional Review Board at the University of Pittsburgh. Final dataset provided is fully anonymized and normalized.

GeneratedBy.Name: Manual
GeneratedBy.Description: All lesion masks manually drawn and checked. Normalized brains and lesion masks with enantiomorphic registration (see Nachev et al., 2008 and Rorden et al., 2012) in MATLAB R2022b. Applied 4mm Gaussian full-width half-maximum smoothing kernel to normalized lesion masks.
